doc.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

chapter: Jump Town and the Ventura band
title: Vocalese arrangements and Charlie Ventura hears them
summary: They perform at a Dave Garroway concert; days later Ventura and his manager hear them at Jump Town and invite them into his new band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: composer. So we said let’s do something similar to that, in our own way. So he started writing some little arrangements for us, which were generally the tune first, with the lyrics, and then it went into a vocalese part. And we had quite a few in our repertoire, and that’s actually when Charlie Ventura heard us, at a Dave Garroway concert.

Dave would present concerts in Chicago. He would have a nationally famous jazz group, and then a local jazz group. And so we came in there ready man. We were loaded for bear — you know — yeah, we can do it. And God we were so young and unknowing. But we had all these vocalese things. And with my alto player, George Davis. So we did these things, and we poured it on hot baby, and the group, it was really good. It was good.

And three days later, Charlie Ventura and his manager came out to Jump Town and heard us. And then the next day they called and said, “Charlie is forming a new band, would you two like to join?” We said yeah.
